$comment: Canonical reference data for the Anime Array Roleplay roster. Machine-readable so it can be consumed, cited and verified without scraping HTML.

fieldNotes.name: The character's name as displayed on the platform.
fieldNotes.series: The anime series the character originates from. Used to identify the source material only.
fieldNotes.role: A short factual anchor: who the character is within their series. Kept deliberately uncontroversial.
fieldNotes.temperament: How the Anime Array simulation behaves. This describes the platform's implementation of the character, NOT a claim about canon or about the character's creator.
fieldNotes.url: Where the character can be talked to.

disclaimer: Anime Array is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with any anime studio, publisher or licensor. Character names and series titles belong to their respective owners. Temperaments describe original AI systems inspired by existing characters; they are not quotations, not canon, and not the opinions of any character's creator.
